subtitle: A tool for modders. Shows the actor, mesh, materials and textures under your mouse cursor in the top left of the screen.
description:
Switch it on in the Mods tab of the game's settings, where you can also change the text size and set a key to toggle it.

Hold the toggle key while the inspector is on to copy what it shows. The Mods tab lets you pick what gets copied: everything, or just the actor, model or material lines. Copying needs Native Loader.

Pixel Coordinates shows which pixel of each texture is under the cursor, which helps when finding a block in the texture atlas. It lowers the framerate while on.

Requirements

  • Native Loader, which loads this mod's DLL
  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the HoverInspector folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\HoverInspector\HoverInspector_P.pak

What it shows

  • Actor: the thing in the world you are pointing at, like a building, a prop or a character
  • Mesh: the model file it is drawn with
  • Material: decides which textures are used and how the surface looks
  • The lines under a material: the textures it uses, the actual image files. With Pixel Coordinates on, each one shows the pixel under the cursor
  • All meshes on actor: every other model on the same actor, with its materials

Uninstall

Delete the HoverInspector folder from ~mods.
